description: DEPRECATED, renamed to org.llmtelemetry.errorMetrics (OTEL-TASK, see MIGRATION.md). This file is KEPT and still read forever because every record already published under this NSID is signed and immutable and can never be rewritten (permanent dual-read). New publishers emit org.llmtelemetry.errorMetrics with OTel GenAI field names; this schema is retained only so legacy records keep validating and rendering. Provider error statistics emitted by an OmniRoute node. Counts and latency percentiles only - no prompts, request/response bodies, or PII. The canonical record shape (Q6 CLOSED, REDESIGN-TASK §1): a flat per-provider status record reporting the SPECIFIC provider error codes observed in the window - codes a human can look up in that provider's docs (HTTP status + provider-specific, e.g. 429 rate_limit, 503, 500, anthropic 529 overloaded, openai 429 insufficient_quota) - instead of an abstract circuit-breaker state. The `circuitBreaker` open/closed concept is gone. Records carry in-band correlation fields (`seq`, `emittedAt`) so an AppView can tie an indexed record back to the exact ping that caused it with no side channel (PHASE-4 §3). This is the shape publishers emit today and the one the ingest path validates against (SPEC-COMPLIANCE §4 / F-2 closed).

main.description: Flat per-provider status record (pull-pds-spec.md §3.2 shape, error-code redesign). One record per (provider, model) observed in the window; rkey is typically the provider name.

errors.description: Specific error codes observed in the window with per-code counts. `code` is the provider-facing status or error code ("429", "503", "529", "insufficient_quota", ...). Sums to `totalErrors`.

totalErrors.description: Total errored requests in the window (sum of `errors[].count`).

observedAt.description: When the reporting node observed this state.

seq.description: Monotonic per-publisher correlation sequence (PHASE-4). Part of the signed record; not a side channel.

emittedAt.description: ISO-8601 (ms) mutation time, stamped by the publisher at write. Correlation field (PHASE-4).

statusReport.description: Deprecated alias of `main`'s record shape, kept as a named ref for any consumer still importing `app.omniroute.errorReport#statusReport`. Identical fields to `main`.

errors.description: Specific error codes observed in the window with per-code counts. Sums to `totalErrors`.

totalErrors.description: Total errored requests in the window (sum of `errors[].count`).

observedAt.description: When the reporting node observed this state.

emittedAt.description: ISO-8601 (ms) mutation time, stamped by the publisher at write (PHASE-4).

code.description: Provider-facing error code, e.g. "429", "503", "529", "insufficient_quota". Look it up in that provider's docs.

count.description: How many times this code was observed in the window.
